item.name: TC-008 - Player completes a Slot session and starts a Gambit session with the updated balance
item.description: Verifies that a player can start a Slot session, reroll a reel, cash out, and then start a Gambit session, with the ChipBalance correctly updated at every step; the Gambit session is then fully played out (every purchased card burned, auto-resolving any selection event or REVEAL/PEEK_CARDS interaction along the way) and cashed out too, so the folder always ends with the player free to start a new game. Uses the shared tables 'Slot 1' and 'Gambit 1', created manually by each developer (see test/api/SHARED_SETUP.md) - nothing in this repo creates them. The player itself IS created live, right here in the first request's pre-request script (self-contained, same pattern as TC-002), so this folder keeps working whether it's run from the terminal (npm run test:api:tc008) or by clicking Send directly in the Postman app. Balance deltas are asserted against the actual cost/reward fields each endpoint returns (MinimumSpinValue, MinimumRerollValue, CardPrice), not against a hard-coded final number, because both the Slot reward and the Gambit result are randomized and only become known from the API's own responses.
